text_block_list.text:
One evening, when I visited the dance 
studio――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Like this? No, perhaps like this? Hmm... 
It feels as though something is lacking――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-san! You seem even more fired 
up than usual.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Tarumae-san. The truth is, 
there is something I must prepare for.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Prepare for?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am scheduled to be interviewed 
alongside Gentil-san soon――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I want to thoroughly refine my posture and 
presence so there is not the slightest 
flaw.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Tarumae-san, if you wouldn't 
mind, could you lend me your insight as a 
local idol?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have reviewed myself countless times, 
but... somehow it never feels quite 
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If someone like me is alright, then of 
course! I'll do my absolute best to help!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: How about... this?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, your posture looks amazing! All 
that's left is――the aura, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-san always wears such a confident 
expression, so if you could project an 
equal sense of composure...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Composure... Indeed. However, how should I 
go about doing that...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's hard to put into words, but 
using something as a reference... Ah, for 
instance――!

The two scrutinized photos and videos of 
various Umamusume. Neither willing to 
compromise in the slightest, they 
continued late into the night.

And on the day of the interview―― I was 
also at the venue to assist.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Now then, could each of you give us your 
thoughts and determination for the next 
race! Starting with Gentildonna-san!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate overwhelming strength. 
――That is all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how powerful...! Next up, 
Verxina-san, if you please!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
―― Up until now, I have accumulated 
unceasing effort.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Believing in myself and aiming for greater 
heights. Therefore, I shall stay true to 
my convictions on the track and charge 
straight forward.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ooh, equally resolute and dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-san. I truly look forward to 
meeting you on the racetrack once again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Indeed. I shall accept that 
resolve of yours.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what an intensely passionate 
moment...! We won't be able to take our 
eyes off either of you going forward!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san, great job out there!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You were so dignified and cool! Standing 
side by side with Gentil-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you♪ It was all thanks to your 
cooperation, Tarumae-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The bearing of our seniors who walked the 
Tiara route and achieved magnificent 
results.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It was because you suggested we reference 
them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No way, I only made a suggestion. It was 
all the fruit of your own hard work, 
Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I've always respected that about you. 
Your stoic dedication, Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Onee-chaaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I saw you~! Declaring your resolve right 
to Gentil-san was super duper cool!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: My, you came to watch? Thank you, Vivlos♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're totally my pride and joy, Big Sis~♡ 
Hey hey, do that pose from earlier one 
more time! I wanna send a pic to 
Cheval-chi!

Verxina's hard work bore magnificent 
fruit, and a wonderful article was 
published at a later date.
